item.title: Cover one hour at a charity desk
item.context_text: Two volunteers have a gap between their shifts. You can fill the gap but need to leave on time.
item.objective_text: Agree on short cover and give the next volunteer the information they need.
success_conditions: Agree on short cover and give the next volunteer the information they need.

children.title: Read the shift list
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Ali: 10–12. Bea: 1–3. Give every donor a receipt. Spare receipt books are in the desk drawer. Leave the desk only if another volunteer is there.

questions.explanation: Ali leaves at noon and Bea starts at one.
The shift list requires a receipt for each donor.

children.title: Hear Bea’s travel message
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: I can be there on time if the bus arrives. My phone is on. If I am more than five minutes late, call Jo at the next desk. I need to know which receipt book you opened.

questions.prompt: Who should you call if Bea is late by more than five minutes?
questions.explanation: Bea names Jo as the backup.

questions.prompt: What does Bea need to know at handover?
questions.explanation: She specifically asks about the open receipt book.

children.title: Confirm your cover with Ali
children.prompt_text: Ali asks if you can take over at noon.
children.instructions: Say when you are available and ask Ali to show you where the extra supplies are.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Yes, I can cover from noon to one. Can you show me where the spare receipt books are before you go? I have not used this desk before.

children.title: Leave a handover note
children.prompt_text: You opened the blue receipt book and there is a spare white one. Bea has just arrived.
children.instructions: Say what you used, where the spare is, and what each new donor needs. Give the backup contact if Bea has to step away.
children.goal: Agree on short cover and give the next volunteer the information they need.
children.model_answer: Hi Bea, I used the receipt book with the blue cover. The white spare receipt book is in the desk drawer. Please give every donor a receipt. If you need to leave the desk, call Jo at the next desk and wait for Jo to take over.

points.label: Identify the open book
any: receipt book with the blue cover
